settings.heading:
Foam holds heat.
Springs do not.
settings.lede: A solid foam mattress is a solid block, and a block has nowhere for warm air to go. Ours is twenty centimetres of open spring core, with the foam kept to the top where it is cut to let air move.

settings.heading: Where the heat goes
settings.card_1_body: Four hundred gram cool-knit. Open-structured, so it does not trap what the layers beneath give off.
settings.card_2_body: Two and a half centimetres of foam cut in a wave profile. The channels are where the air goes when you move.
settings.card_3_body: Twenty centimetres of pocket springs is mostly air. Foam blocks hold heat because there is nowhere for it to go. This has somewhere.

settings.heading: It will not make you cold.
settings.body_1: No mattress does. Cooling gel in a solid block warms up within an hour and stays warm. What a mattress can do is not add to the problem, and let the heat you make leave.
settings.body_2: The gel layer here is one centimetre, on top, where it can dissipate. It is not the mechanism. The springs are.

settings.kicker: If it is still too warm
settings.heading: Tell us.
settings.body_1: Heat is usually a comfort layer question. A firmer face keeps you higher on the surface, which is cooler. Turn it over first. If that is not enough, tell us, and we build a new layer to what you describe. For a year, with our compliments.
settings.pull: You do not choose the feel. You discover it. Temperature is part of feel.

settings.a1_body: A year to tell us how it should feel. We remake the comfort layer to that, with our compliments, as often as it takes.
settings.a2_body: Collected from your home and refunded in full. Emperor is made to order and excluded.
settings.a3_body: The part that carries you is guaranteed for a quarter of a century.

settings.heading: Choose your size
settings.lede: Every size is the same build. Thirty five centimetres, seven-zone core, removable comfort layer. You do not choose a firmness.
